schemas.source:
export type ApplicationMode = 'installed' | 'portable' | 'development' | 'unpacked'
export type UpdateStatus = 'disabled' | 'idle' | 'checking' | 'not-available' | 'available' | 'downloading' | 'ready' | 'installing' | 'error'
export interface UpdateState {
  enabled: boolean
  status: UpdateStatus
  currentVersion: string
  targetVersion?: string
  releaseNotes?: string
  lastCheckAt?: string
  progress?: { percent: number; transferred: number; total: number; bytesPerSecond: number }
  error?: string
  canInstall?: boolean
}
export interface UpdatesBridge {
  getState(): Promise<UpdateState>
  check(): Promise<UpdateState>
  download(): Promise<UpdateState>
  install(): Promise<UpdateState>
  onStateChanged(callback: (state: UpdateState) => void): () => void
}
type OcrPlugin = { installed: boolean; enabled: boolean; version: string; sizeBytes: number }
export type GraphSelection = { type: 'node'; node: GraphNode } | { type: 'edge'; edge: GraphEdge }

export interface WorkbenchAction {
  id: string
  label: string
  keywords?: string
  shortcut?: string
  danger?: boolean
  hidden?: boolean
  disabledReason?: string
  run: () => void | Promise<void>
}

export interface ConfirmRequest { title: string; description: string; confirmLabel?: string; danger?: boolean; onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void> }

OCR install/PATCH/DELETE 均同步返回 OcrPlugin JSON，已补齐泛型类型；不是导入 Job 或204响应。
